items.head: Life starts going well
items.sub: Some people only like you while you're struggling.

items.head: You're angry
items.sub: One sentence can undo years of respect.

items.head: You're planning a big move
items.sub: Talking about it feels like doing it. Build first.

items.head: Someone tells you a secret
items.sub: Repeat it once and nobody trusts you again.

items.head: The room loves gossip
items.sub: Whoever tells you everyone's business tells yours.

items.head: Someone underestimates you
items.sub: Skip the speech. Let your results answer.

label: NUMBER 7
head: You're about to buy a car or a house
sub: Some will talk you out of it. Others start counting your money.

text: A man who guards his words *runs everything else.*
